meta.name: ASAS Real Estate OS — State Machine Register
meta.implementation_rule: One StateMachine implementation, every lifecycle: transition tables exactly as below; illegal transition returns a typed error; no setter exists for status columns; every transition appends audit (actor, reason) and fires the corresponding domain event.
meta.enum_warning: Enum values are character-for-character normative. PENDING_DEPOSIT, not PendingDeposit or AWAITING_DEPOSIT.

B.2_apartment_construction_status.transitions: Linear forward chain, driven by milestone.certified events per building; regressions forbidden except by director-approved change order.

B.3_lead_lifecycle_track_a.transitions: NEW → CONTACTED → QUALIFIED → OPPORTUNITY → CUSTOMER; terminal UNQUALIFIED, BAD_TIMING. System-controlled, forward-only.

B.4_lead_working_status_track_a2.transitions: Rep-controlled; any inbound engagement auto-promotes to CONNECTED.

B.5_opportunity_pipeline.transitions: Forward chain QUALIFIED → … → WON_PAID; LOST / WITHDRAWN reachable from any open stage; stage entry validates exit criteria; offer expiry may regress OFFER_SENT → NEGOTIATION or QUALIFIED, audited.

B.6_reservation.transitions: DRAFT → PENDING_DEPOSIT → ACTIVE → CONVERTED | CANCELLED → REFUND_PROCESSING → CLOSED. Expiry of PENDING_DEPOSIT triggers auto-cancel approval; cooling period applies before unit returns AVAILABLE.

B.7_contract.transitions: DRAFT → GENERATED → SIGNED → NOTARIZED → ACTIVE → COMPLETED | TERMINATED | RESCINDED. Law 11-04 field validation gates GENERATED.

B.8_payment_schedule_item.transitions: PENDING → DUE → INVOICED → PARTIALLY_PAID → PAID; DUE|PARTIALLY_PAID → OVERDUE; any → WAIVED when approved; terminal CANCELLED on contract termination.

B.9_approval_request.transitions: PENDING → APPROVED | REJECTED | ESCALATED | EXPIRED | CANCELLED; decisions append-only; APPROVED/REJECTED resume requesting flow.

B.10_studio_page_version.transitions: DRAFT → IN_REVIEW → PUBLISHED → ARCHIVED; rollback = publish of a prior version as a new version.
B.10_studio_page_version.note: v1.6.1: statuses are enum-backed in asas-contracts.prisma.

B.11_appointment.transitions: REQUESTED → CONFIRMED → IN_PROGRESS → COMPLETED | NO_SHOW; CONFIRMED/IN_PROGRESS → cancellation states; reschedule closes current appointment as RESCHEDULED and spawns linked successor.
